# Roboto

The UI typeface. Staged into `fonts/roboto/` beside the executable so both Qt and OpenCascade can load it as a file.

- Upstream: [googlefonts/roboto-3-classic](https://github.com/googlefonts/roboto-3-classic), release v3.016
- Files: `Roboto-Regular.ttf` and `Roboto-Medium.ttf` from `chromeos/static` in the release zip, the hinted full character set
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, `OFL.txt` from the repository root. It allows bundling as long as the license ships alongside.

Static Regular and Medium only. Medium replaces bold everywhere in the UI.
